$comment: Guildcrest (Chapter 04: Skills and Custom Agents), docs/specs/ISLAND-04-guildcrest.md §4. Its cast ids, story names, signs, cues and compass ids are the game’s contract (the spec’s § Wiring contract). Written ahead of its island.

tracker.goal: Save your craft as skills and agents, and earn the Seal of Guildcrest
tracker.next: Sunspire Sands is next, and she’s still being charted. Until then these waters are yours.

steps.start: Lyra’s playing on the inn’s porch, at the quay’s head.
steps.done: A skill is the chart for one kind of job. A custom agent is the specialist who follows it. You still check the result.

steps.start: Reeve Elspeth keeps the Charter Stone on Guild Square.
steps.done: A prompt is for now. Instructions are the house rules. A skill is for work you repeat. A custom agent is a role with its own tools.

link.label: Create the session in the app ↗

steps.start: Brother Aidan keeps the abbey’s gate, up the Kirk Brae.
steps.done: One session in a new worktree from main, kept for every exercise. Its edits stay in its worktree.

link.label: Update the skill in the app ↗

steps.start: Sister Brigid runs the scriptorium, through the cloister.
steps.book: Walk the Pattern Book round the cloister.
steps.solved: Every lamp on the cloister walk is lit. Talk to Brigid.
steps.done: A skill is a folder with a SKILL.md file. Update it, reload it, and check its activity against the files.

quests.title: The Chained Library
quests.task: See what a skill can’t do

steps.start: Brother Ewan keeps the chained library, along the cloister.
steps.done: A skill guides the work. It doesn’t switch off any tools, so read a skill before you turn it on.

quests.title: Hire a Specialist
quests.task: Learn what makes a custom agent

steps.start: Guildmaster Fergus is at the guildhall, out the east gate.
steps.done: A custom agent has a name, instructions and a set of tools. It’s a role, not a mode or a model.

link.label: Create the agent in the app ↗

steps.start: Talk to Fergus again in the guildhall yard.
steps.belt: Fit out Rory’s toolbelt in the yard.
steps.solved: Every lamp in the yard is lit. Talk to Fergus.
steps.done: The tools list is the limit: read and search only. Quit and reopen the app to load it, then pick it with /agent.

quests.title: The Toolbelt Trial
quests.task: Pass the Trial to earn the Seal

steps.start: Abbess Seren waits at the bell tower.
steps.exam: The Toolbelt Trial is ready when you are.
steps.done: The Seal of Guildcrest is yours.

link.label: Do the assignment in the app ↗

steps.start: Seren has one more job for you.
steps.try: Do the assignment in the app, then show Seren.
steps.done: One focused change from the skill’s review, tests and build passing, and an honest record.

lyra.caption: The bandleader hands out a chart, so everyone plays this song the same way.

elspeth.caption: A one-off prompt, or a skill: a reusable checklist that lives in the repository.

brigid.solved.caption: ① **Customize** · ② the **Installed** tab · ③ the **Skills** type filter · ④ `book-app-reviewer`, with its toggle on.

fergus.caption: You call the specialist: a plumber, an electrician, a roofer.

fergus.belt.solved.caption: Type `/agent`, then select **book-app-explainer** and send the command.

notes.lyra: The song chart (puzzles/song-chart.json, the gc-chart cue): Callum and Isla play from memory, out of step; the player hands out the chart and they play together. Harp’s Return joins the Songbook (04 · from-the-studio-a-song-chart-for-the-session).
notes.elspeth: The Charter Stone (gc-charter) frames M4.1, the course's four-row table; then the one-off prompt image and K4.2.
notes.aidan: The practice session: K4.3 and its card (A4.1). The carrel key is the session in a new worktree from main.
notes.brigid: The Pattern Book (puzzles/pattern-book.json): the brief sets the book step, and the lap opens (gc-book). The lap's end sets solved and plays brigid.solved at once.
notes.brigid.solved: The lap's close: the Customize spyglass (H4.1), the skill pages, both cards (A4.2, A4.3), and chest C4.1 in the book press opens.
notes.ewan: The chained library (gc-chains): the page says "review without carving", and the apprentice still holds the chisel. K4.5 is the course's IMPORTANT note (04 · core-concepts).
notes.fergus: Hiring specialists, K4.6, the agent pages. Q4.7 starts; talk to Fergus again in the yard (fergus.belt).
notes.fergus.belt: The Journeyman's Toolbelt (puzzles/toolbelt.json): the belt step, and the lap opens (gc-belt). The lap's end plays fergus.belt.solved.
notes.fergus.belt.solved: The lap's close: Rory's line, the agent picker spyglass (H4.2), the explainer pages, both cards (A4.4, A4.5), and chest C4.3 in the yard opens.
notes.seren: Leaving the Trial ends the script; next time Seren skips her introduction (seren.retry). The reflection comes before the Seal.
notes.trial.passed: The Seal: gc-seal rings the bell three times, the swifts burst from the belfry, and the guild banners unfurl along the ridge (§4.5).
notes.seren.assignment: Optional, after the Seal: the assignment card goes quietly, and Seren asks when you're back.
notes.seren.assignment.back: Later ends the talk; I did it shows K4.9, the success criteria.
notes.barks.gc_kid: The second bark paraphrases 04 · choose-the-feature-that-fits-the-task (a one-off prompt).
notes.barks.brigid: Her barks after Q4.4 point to Ewan (nav); the second paraphrases 04 · skills-save-a-review-checklist.
notes.barks.gc_shepherd: The second bark paraphrases 04 · key-takeaways (check the result).

gc_fiddler: Isla, you’re a beat ahead again!
With the chart on the stand, we play it the same every night.
gc_whistler: I’m not ahead, Callum. You’re behind!
Lyra’s chart doesn’t play the tune for us. We still have to play it well.
gc_kid: Errands! Who needs an errand run?
Tell me once and I’ll do it once, Captain. Ask me again tomorrow.
gc_copyist: Two new rules, and not a word more.
gc_miller: The mill grinds the same flour every day. Same chart, same job.
gc_shepherd: Mind the heather, Captain. It hides the burn.
I count the flock every evening. The dog says they’re all there, but I count anyway.
brigid: Brother Ewan’s along the north walk, Captain. Ask him what a book can’t do.
One book per craft, and its spine says when to fetch it.
rory: I read and I search. I don’t carve, and I don’t claim the tests passed.
Need something changed? That’s the guild’s own crew, Captain, not me.
